issue.title: Multiple go_repository rules with same name should be an error
issue.body:
If the WORKSPACE contains multiple go_repository() rules with the same name but different commits, the first is silently ignored.

bazelbuild/bazel#1984 discusses rule redefinition in Bazel, where it is an error after the first `load()` statement. 

### Reproduction

```
# WORKSPACE
http_archive(
    name = "io_bazel_rules_go",
    sha256 = "f7e42a4c1f9f31abff9b2bdee6fe4db18bc373287b7e07a5b844446e561e67e2",
    strip_prefix = "rules_go-4c9a52aba0b59511c5646af88d2f93a9c0193647",
    urls = [
        "http://bazel-mirror.storage.googleapis.com/github.com/bazelbuild/rules_go/archive/4c9a52aba0b59511c5646af88d2f93a9c0193647.tar.gz",
        "https://github.com/bazelbuild/rules_go/archive/4c9a52aba0b59511c5646af88d2f93a9c0193647.tar.gz",
    ],
)

load("@io_bazel_rules_go//go:def.bzl", "go_repositories", "go_repository")

go_repositories()

go_repository(
    name = "protobuf",
    commit = "123456789",
    importpath = "github.com/golang/protobuf",
)

go_repository(
    name = "protobuf",
    commit = "ab9f9a6dab164b7d1246e0e688b0ab7b94d8553e",
    importpath = "github.com/golang/protobuf",
)
```

`bazel build @protobuf//...` doesn't complain about the invalid first rule. (although it fails due to having no targets)

### Expected behaviour

Bazel fails and, ideally, reports where the conflicting rules were defined.

### Environment info
* Operating System: Ubuntu 14.04
* Bazel version: 0.5.3

issue.body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

On Windows, if `//src:foo` depends on `@repo2//:gen`, which is a Starlark rule whose definition is in `@repo1//:gen_cc.bzl`, then changing `gen_cc.bzl` does not trigger a rebuild of `//src:foo` even though it should.

On Linux, the same thing works correctly.

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

https://github.com/laszlocsomor/projects/tree/81325c41c015dfe02d7639ab8940f52d72da8093/bazel/starlark-rule-change-no-picked-up-from-repo

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

Windows 10

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

`release 0.21.0`

body: The fix (https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/337f19cc54e77c45daa1d5f61bf0a8d3daf8268f) was apparently rolled back (https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/766ba8adc4487f17ebfc081aeba6f34b18b53d6c) so I've reopened the bug.
I confirmed that the bug is still present in Bazel 0.21.0 -- it was never fixed.
And the bug is also present on Linux.
